findings: New second-wave template distilled from a recurring field workflow pattern; no prior library source existed to audit.
The field pattern relied on free-text inputs and live services that a portable template cannot reproduce deterministically.
The field pattern carried organization-specific names, systems and identifiers that cannot appear in a public template.
fixes: Rebuilt the workflow as 6 deterministic operations over a fixed fictional snapshot for Fabrikam Information Services.
Replaced free-text and numeric inputs with an operation enum and demo defaults so every output is reproducible and pipeline-friendly.
Generalized every name, system, identifier and figure to invented values and verified zero overlap with the pattern sources.
Kept every external action as a labeled draft with an explicit no-send, no-change, human-approval boundary.
remaining_boundary: Production connections and all external actions require customer approval, least-privilege controls, and an authorized human workflow.
